_doc: Virel's surfaces (docs/kb/art/creatures/vowbound/virel.md). Slots are the glTF material names; write_materials.py writes assets/creatures/virel/materials/<slot>.tres on game/shaders/creature/creature.gdshader. She is bound light (color_script.md rule 2; act1_ch08.md F07 and section 9 item 2): every emissive slot is glimmer_bound #4FB3B0 at energy 1.2 with no pulse (steady: no flicker, no drift, no shed motes). Her fire is bound, so her seams are glimmer_bound, never ember_orange: ember_orange is 'flame and horizon only; never a surface albedo' and the Fire VFX base, so fire-coloured light belongs to her attack VFX and Flare Line (battle-vfx's), never to her form. sail is all the cloth (M3-CRB-008): the panels (sand, tanned, sun-faded, stained, scorched to char round every seam), the mends, the hem tapes (their stitching smoulders: a patchy mask), the head's cheeks, jaw, frills and pennant (the inside of the head and mouth glows), the streamers and bows. seam is the bound fire: the cross-seams' burning cores and ember rings, the head's lip and neck seams, the frozen flame tongues and the lantern-eyes (emission masks 0.06-1). spar is the cane frame (bamboo: thatch to timber_weathered, darker nodes), cord the lashings, bridle, whiskers, tassels and the key's cord, key the brass tuning key and the hem grommets: the keepsake, not lit (worn bright on its rim: the glint). Colours are palette.json swatches.

held._doc: M3-CRE-647, the held form for the Ch20 release fight (act3_roster.md, The Vowbound as foes): write_materials.py writes materials_held/, every emissive slot's glimmer_bound (#4FB3B0) as glimmer_held (#7FC6D9) at the same energy, steady (color_script.md rule 1: held light is cool cyan); the other slots as they are. The held battle scene wears it; the release turns it to glimmer_lift (presentation).
